name: html-inline-button-form-submit-unaffected
description: Negative guard: the inline-button-in-paragraph fix never applies to a button with a <form> ancestor. An explicit type="submit" control inside a <form> keeps materializing as a native authored submit control, not RichText.

source_reference.notes: Same button label as html-inline-button-in-paragraph-becomes-native.json, wrapped in a <form> with an explicit submit type, to prove FormControlClassifier::hasFormAncestor() still excludes it from inline RichText promotion.

legacy_comparison.reason: Negative guard for new inline-button-in-paragraph promotion.
